about: compiler/fingerprint mutants covering canonical framing, dependency cleanup, early cutoff, and interface projection

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-no-length-prefix
mutants.rule: OfInto must length-prefix every framed input so [ab, c] never collides with [a, bc].

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-unsorted-deps
mutants.from: out = slices.SortFunc(out, func(a DepPrint, b DepPrint) int { strings.Compare(a.Path, b.Path) })
mutants.rule: CleanDeps must canonically sort dependency fingerprints so permutation never alters ImplementationPrint or Reusable.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-ignore-dep-interface
mutants.rule: Reusable must check dependency interface digests, not path presence alone.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-cutoff-always-dirty
mutants.from: let ifaceChanged = oldChangedID == NoPkg || prev.IfacePrints[int(oldChangedID)] != cur.IfacePrints[int(changedID)]
mutants.to: let ifaceChanged = oldChangedID == NoPkg || prev.SrcPrints[int(oldChangedID)] != cur.SrcPrints[int(changedID)]
mutants.rule: ComputeDirty must cut off downstream propagation when a changed dependency leaves its exported interface digest unchanged.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-interface-leaks-private
mutants.rule: InterfaceText must exclude unexported functions so private helper edits do not invalidate downstream interface fingerprints.

mutants.name: selfhost-build-fp-include-func-body-in-iface
mutants.rule: InterfaceText must slice exported functions before their bodies so implementation-only edits preserve the interface digest.
